svg.title: Orion 24/12-70
svg.desc: Exact orthographic outline extracted from Victron Energy dimension drawing. Connector-end front projection, not the long top/mounting projection. Footprint in this view is91×67mm; axial body depth195mm. Input/output negatives are aliases of one common negative post, not separate isolated terminals. Polarity locations checked against official product front photo; this derivative contains no photo.
